h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Motihari

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Motihari

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Motihari

c: Motihari, the headquarters of East Champaran, is where Gandhi began his Champaran Satyagraha, and the town lies close to Bihar's border with Nepal. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Motihari for schools, colleges, district grounds, residential colonies and the municipal body. Every machine is made at our Vasai factory, about 1470 km away, and sent to north Bihar by road.

Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India fixes the equipment on site. North Bihar has a long, heavy monsoon, and rivers in the region often flood the plains. Humid summers and foggy winters follow. Galvanised frames resist rust in this climate, but the bigger question is ground. We pick the highest part of your site and set the machines on a raised concrete base with drainage.

richText.heading: A compact gym for a school or district campus

c: Where flooding is possible, fewer footings are easier to protect. The

items.q: What should we do if our school ground floods?
items.a: Choose the highest corner for the gym and build a raised base. Once the water drains, clean the machines, check every bolt and call us if any part looks damaged.

items.q: Is a combination machine a good choice for a small budget?
items.a: Yes. A frame with three exercises on one footing needs less ground preparation than three separate machines, and it gives a school a usable gym from the start.

items.q: Do you supply to East Champaran?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai, and our team or a dealer in eastern India installs the machines once you approve the layout and quote.
